publishedExpectations.claim: Role summary: options market making combines scale with complexity, 'over a million listed options at the heart of billions of messages' handled on co-located hardware constrained by latency requirements, forcing algorithmic and business innovation.

Skills and qualifications in an official posting: experience working in C++, experience with distributed systems, sound understanding of multi-threaded application design and development, plus strong communication skills for a dynamic trading environment.
The posting expects engineers to master the options trading domain itself ('treating the problems as data-in, data-out technical challenges is not enough') and translate it into software solutions.

From the same posting: engineers build, maintain and support 'one of the world's most powerful trading platforms', continuously improving performance, functionality and stability, and provide timely systems support for trading activities.

Hiring for quant-dev seats appears to stress open-ended analytical problem solving: the posting lists 'ambition to solve open-ended problems using analytical methods' and self-directed prioritisation of high-impact projects.

notes: The firm's own career site (citadelsecurities.com/careers) was blocked by a bot check at retrieval time, so this profile is built from an official Citadel Securities job posting retrieved via LinkedIn's public job API (Senior Options Software Engineer, New York). The posting is explicit about the stack: C++, distributed systems, multi-threading, and latency constrained by exchange co-location.
